summary: Completed comprehensive E2E testing of Customer Portal 10-stage Project Milestone Tracker. Backend APIs (100% pass rate - 52/52 tests) and frontend UI/integration (all core flows working) verified successfully. Seeded 'Belli Residence' project with 3 completed stages and stage 4 (Booking) at 55% progress confirmed working in both admin panel and customer portal.

Backend: Duplicate email check - Correctly returns 409 when project exists for same email
Backend: PUT /api/admin/projects/{id} - Updates project title/address/status
Backend: PATCH /api/admin/projects/{id}/stages/{index} - Updates stage status/notes/progress_pct/expected_date with auto-timestamps
Backend: Stage status transitions - Auto-stamps started_at when status changes to 'in_progress', auto-stamps completed_at and sets progress to 100 when status changes to 'completed'
Backend: DELETE /api/admin/projects/{id} - Deletes project successfully
Backend: GET /api/portal/my-project (unauth) - Correctly returns 401 when no customer session cookie
Backend: GET /api/portal/my-project (with session) - Returns customer's project with correct data (Belli Residence, stage 4 at 55%)
